ipxact:component.ipxact:name: efx_csi2_tx_top
ipxact:component.ipxact:description: The MIPI 2.5G CSI-2 TX Controller interfaces with the harden MIPI DPHY blocks in Titanium devices

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: PACK_TYPE
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Enables the controller to pack different pixel data type. Only enable the pack type that you are using to save logic resources. 4’b0001: Pack 40 4’b0010: Pack 48 4’b0100: Pack 56 4’b1000: Pack 64 4’b0011: Pack 40 or 48 4’b0101: Pack 40 or 56 4’b1111: Pack all types (default) Pack 40 RAW10, RAW20, YUV_420_10, YUV_422_10. Pack 48 RAW6, RAW12, RAW24, RGB888, YUV_420_8_legacy. Pack 56 RAW7, RAW14, RAW28. Pack 64 RAW8, RAW16, RGB444, RGB565, RGB555, YUV_422_8, YUV_420_8, generic long packet, user define 8- bit, embedded 8-bit non image packet.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tINIT_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: D-PHY timing parameter in ns. Values according to MIPI D-PHY specifications.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tINIT_SKEWCAL_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: D-PHY timing parameter in ns. Values according to MIPI D-PHY specifications. (only valid when "Enable Init Skew Calibration" is turned on.)

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: HS_BYTECLK_MHZ
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: MIPI parallel clock frequency in Mhz to support data rate of 80 Mbps to 2500 Mbps.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: DPHY_CLOCK_MODE
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: To enable discontinuous or continuous HS mode clock.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: PIXEL_FIFO_DEPTH
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: FIFO depth size that stores the pixel packet data.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: Pack_48
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Enable Pack 48:RAW6, RAW12, RAW24, RGB888, YUV_420_8_legacy

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: Pack_64
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Enable Pack 64:RAW8, RAW16, RGB444, RGB565, RGB555, YUV_422_8, YUV_420_8, generic long packet, user define 8- bit, embedded 8-bit non image packet

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: ENABLE_VCX
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:displayName: Enable extra bits on Virtual Channel

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: ENABLE_SKEWCAL_INIT
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Skew Calibration can be enabled or disabled during initialization phase. However, this is only applicable to datarate above 1.5Gbps. Please set it to Disable for datarate 1.5Gbps and below. (leverage on HS_BYTECLK_MHZ to figure out the datarate, e.g. HS_BYTECLK_MHZ = datarate / 16.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: MIPI_CSI2_TX_DEBUG
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: This option turns on some debug ports on the IP.
